input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: sidewalk_accessibility. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report damaged sidewalk 311 Public Works
San Francisco curb ramp accessibility request

value.title: Report curb and sidewalk problems | SF.gov
value.excerpt: Report broken, uplifted or obstructed sidewalks and damaged curb ramps. San Francisco Public Works inspects sidewalk defects.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
